title: Best Crisp Alternatives
intro: Crisp's day-to-day usability scores well on G2 and Capterra, but its 1.9/5 Trustpilot rating reflects a real pattern of billing and cancellation complaints. If that gives you pause, or you've simply outgrown Crisp's workspace-based pricing, here's where to look next.

entries.blurb: The step up in scale and independent review depth (2,900+ G2 reviews vs. Crisp's smaller base), if you're willing to pay per-seat plus per-resolution AI fees for a more proven platform.
A comparably-priced live chat and AI agent alternative with a stronger, more consistent independent review record (4.6-4.7/5 across sites) than Crisp's split reputation.
If what you actually valued in Crisp was the Instagram/WhatsApp/Messenger side rather than the shared inbox, ManyChat specializes specifically in comment-to-DM and social messaging automation.
